mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO selected_stock ( strategy_code, stock_code, stock_name, selection_date, selection_close_price, next_day_open_price, remark, gain_1day, gain_3day, gain_7day ) VALUES
( #{item.strategyCode}, #{item.stockCode}, #{item.stockName}, #{item.selectionDate}, #{item.selectionClosePrice}, #{item.nextDayOpenPrice}, #{item.remark}, #{item.gain1day}, #{item.gain3day}, #{item.gain7day} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), remark = VALUES(remark), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE selected_stock SET selection_close_price = #{selectionClosePrice}, next_day_open_price = #{nextDayOpenPrice}, gain_1day = #{gain1day}, gain_3day = #{gain3day}, gain_7day = #{gain7day}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM selected_stock ORDER BY selection_date DESC, strategy_code, stock_code
